objects.name: c_margin_markup
objects.expression: 'Margin : ' +  string(((saleprice - purprice) / if( saleprice = 0, 1, saleprice)) * 100, '###,##0.00') + '%' + SPACE(20) + 'Mark-Up : ' +  string(((saleprice - purprice) / if( purprice = 0, 1, purprice)) * 100, '###,##0.00') + '%'
